verdict.rationale: mParticle's first-party IDSync documentation describes an identity resolution framework that unifies the customer view and gives control over both known and anonymous identities across apps and platforms. That directly covers the core of the stitching story. Missing for 10: specific documentation of configurable identity-resolution rules (identity priorities, matching and merge strategies), explicit cross-device merge behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, anonymous and known activity stitches into one customer profile across devices, with documented and configurable identity-resolution rules

citations.quote: IDSync is mParticle's identity resolution framework, enabling you to create a unified view of your customers
IDSync gives visibility into, and control over, the management of known and anonymous user identities across apps and platforms.
